text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a larger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to unfair decisions in areas like hiring or banking, so fairness must be a priority. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should handle this data carefully and protect users. Transparency is also essential: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and good for society.
